description: This file defines a class 'Color' responsible for mapping color indices to RGB color values within the context of reading XLS files in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes a static method 'map' that determines the RGB value based on color index, palette, and version.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: A class providing static methods to map color indices to RGB values when reading XLS files.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an indexed color to its RGB representation based on palette and version.
